# optimizelycmp_brand_compliance_category (Data Source)

Looks up one brand compliance category by name. It fails if there is no match or more than one.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "optimizelycmp_brand_compliance_category" "tone" {
  name = "Tone of voice"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Category name (case-insensitive exact match).

### Read-Only

- `criteria_names` (List of String)
- `id` (String) ID of the brand compliance category.
